title: UXID conformance case: deterministic
description: One line of deterministic.json: the inputs of a deterministic (name-based) id and the id a producer emits for them. The delimiter is `_`.

id.description: Stable case id, `deterministic/` and a slug.

prefix.description: The prefix; null for none. An empty string is no prefix too.

from.description: The string the body is a hash of, hashed as its UTF-8 bytes.

case.description: The letter case of the body, the marker included.
